name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data analytics, Amplify Analytix for customer intelligence) targeting financial services with AI-driven customer data platforms. Their methodology centers on predictive analytics, next-best-action decisioning, and hyper-personalization at scale. Delivery model combines offshore India engineering capacity with EU-based consulting. Thought leadership emphasizes GenAI-powered segmentation and real-time CDP capabilities for banking and insurance.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta specializes in bridging SAP operational data with Qualtrics experience data through custom-built embedded analytics interfaces. Their methodology emphasizes closing the O-data/X-data loop within SAP environments using AI agents within BTP workflows. Delivery model is deeply SAP-native with DACH-region consulting expertise. Thought leadership focuses on making experience insights actionable within existing SAP enterprise workflows for manufacturing and financial services.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics is the dominant Qualtrics partner in the GCC region with deep expertise in public sector citizen experience transformation. Their methodology emphasizes government CX maturity frameworks, Arabic-language survey design, and alignment with national digital transformation agendas (Vision 2030, UAE Strategy). Delivery model combines regional on-ground consulting with Qualtrics platform implementation. Thought leadership centers on citizen experience measurement, government service design, and CX maturity benchmarking.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages its massive global research infrastructure to deliver CX measurement programs anchored in behavioral science and advanced analytics. Their methodology emphasizes forces of CX (fair treatment, certainty, control, status, belonging), linking experience metrics to financial outcomes. Delivery model combines proprietary research methodologies with Medallia platform expertise at global enterprise scale. Thought leadership focuses on CX ROI quantification, loyalty driver analysis, and sector-specific consumer behavior benchmarking across retail and financial services.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont positions as a Qualtrics-specialist consultancy with deep technical implementation expertise and strategic CX advisory for mid-market and enterprise clients. Their methodology centers on experience program design, AI agent deployment within Qualtrics, and CX maturity acceleration. Delivery model is US-based consulting with strong Qualtrics certification depth. Thought leadership emphasizes practical AI application within experience management, financial services CX optimization, and Qualtrics platform best practices.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner focused on experience management program design and implementation across UK and European enterprises. Their historical content has emphasized Qualtrics technical best practices and CX program governance. The prolonged content absence makes it difficult to assess current AI stance or methodology evolution. Delivery model appears to be UK/EU-focused boutique consulting with Qualtrics platform specialization.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap operates as a platform-agnostic CX and EX consulting firm across Spain and Latin America, emphasizing human-centered journey design and organizational transformation. Their methodology focuses on customer journey mapping, employee experience co-design, and change management integration. Delivery model is consulting-led without strong technology platform allegiance. Thought leadership centers on the intersection of employee and customer experience, journey-based transformation, and cultural change in Spanish-speaking enterprises.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo positions as the leading CX consultancy across Iberoamerica with Qualtrics-certified implementation capabilities spanning 15+ Spanish-speaking markets. Their methodology emphasizes Voice of Customer program design, CX strategy development, and digital experience optimization. Delivery model combines regional consulting presence with Qualtrics platform expertise across Latin America and Spain. Thought leadership focuses on CX maturity, customer-centric culture transformation, and VoC program best practices for enterprise clients.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant's Connected Experiences Studio positions CX within a broader AI-driven digital transformation narrative, leveraging the company's massive engineering workforce across Latin America and globally. Their methodology emphasizes AI engineering, data-driven experience design, and enterprise-scale digital transformation. Delivery model is large-scale nearshore/offshore engineering combined with strategic consulting. CX-specific thought leadership is subordinated to the dominant corporate AI narrative, with experience transformation framed as an outcome of AI adoption rather than a standalone discipline.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.

name: Acceleration Strategy
blog_profile: Acceleration Strategy is a Canada/US-based Qualtrics partner that has built strong thought leadership around AI agent deployment, experience orchestration, and XM program optimization post-X4 2026. Their methodology emphasizes translating Qualtrics AI product capabilities into actionable enterprise implementation roadmaps. Delivery model is North American consulting with deep Qualtrics certification and partnership alignment. Thought leadership is notably aggressive in analyzing and amplifying new Qualtrics AI features, positioning them as a go-to advisory voice for organizations evaluating AI-powered experience management.
